import array,hashlib,json,socket,time
start=time.monotonic()
paths=[('weight',r'D:\projects\AIMA-public-capture-20260910\build\layer0-weights-r1\qkv.bin',8192),('input',r'D:\projects\AIMA-public-exact-ab-20260910\build\fla-model-q7169-embeddingnorm-capture-r1\input-rmsnorm-bf16.bin',7169)]
reports=[]
for name,path,rows in paths:
 data=open(path,'rb').read();values=array.array('H');values.frombytes(data);assert len(values)==rows*2048
 zero=[];special=0
 for row in range(rows):
  chunk=values[row*2048:(row+1)*2048]
  if not any(x&32767 for x in chunk):zero.append(row)
  special+=sum((x&32767)>=32640 for x in chunk)
 reports.append(dict(name=name,path=path,sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),rows=rows,zero_rows=len(zero),zero_indices=zero,special_values=special))
print(json.dumps(dict(host=socket.gethostname(),reports=reports,wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-start)))
